title: 100i (Origin Jumpworks, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The 100i is a single-seat luxury starter ship from Origin Jumpworks in Star Citizen. Behind the cockpit there is a small living area. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: 100i: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the 100i's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two)
controls.text: The 100i has two guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (two missiles)
controls.text: The 100i carries two missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Cargo (2 SCU)
controls.text: A small space holds 2 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.
